scripts.regulatory:facts: npm run build:submission && node scripts/regulatory-facts.mjs build
scripts.regulatory:facts:check: npm run build:submission && node scripts/regulatory-facts.mjs check
scripts.regulatory:screenshots: npm run build:submission && playwright test --config playwright.submission.config.ts --update-snapshots && node scripts/submission-evidence.mjs build
scripts.regulatory:screenshots:check: npm run build:submission && playwright test --config playwright.submission.config.ts && node scripts/submission-evidence.mjs check
scripts.test:e2e: npm run regulatory:screenshots:check && npm run regulatory:facts:check && npm run build:e2e && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:update-snapshots: npm run build:e2e && UPDATE_E2E_DOCS=1 playwright test --update-snapshots
